d: Delhi is reportedly witnessing its most polluted Diwali in five years, with the city’s average Air Quality Index reaching 376 on November 8. The morning after offered little relief, as the AQI remained at 371, while several neighbourhoods recorded severe pollution levels. In this ground report, Firstpost examines the scale of the crisis, from the smog engulfing India Gate to the struggles of tourists trying to breathe.
